query: PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT DISTINCT ?opThemeMain ?opThemeMain_uri ?opTheme ?opTheme_uri ?opTheme_dateCreated     where     {         {?opTheme_uri rdf:type ?opThemeMain_uri;         skos:prefLabel ?opTheme;         dcterms:created ?opTheme_dateCreated.         ?opThemeMain_uri rdfs:label ?opThemeMain                             }     filter(?opThemeMain_uri=<http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#concept_op_theme>)     FILTER(langMatches(lang(?opTheme), "en")).     filter not exists {         ?opTheme_uri skos:broader ?broader         }     }ORDER BY ?opThemeMain ?opTheme

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>      PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>     PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>     PREFIX org: <http://www.w3.org/ns/org#>     PREFIX vcard: <http://www.w3.org/2006/vcard/ns#>     PREFIX euvoc: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/euvoc#>             SELECT DISTINCT ?membership ?person ?person_uri ?person_gender ?person_genderUri              where {{?person_uri org:hasMembership ?membership_uri;                                 vcard:hasGender ?person_genderUri;                                 foaf:name ?person.                     ?membership_uri euvoc:positionComplement ?membership.                     ?person_genderUri skos:prefLabel ?person_gender.                     }                     filter(?membership_uri=<PARAMETER>)                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?membership), "en")).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?person_gender), "en")).                    }ORDER BY ?person                    #LIMIT 50

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>      PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>     PREFIX org: <http://www.w3.org/ns/org#>     PREFIX geo: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>     PREFIX geosparql: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>     PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>     PREFIX euvoc: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/euvoc#>     PREFIX vcard: <http://www.w3.org/2006/vcard/ns#>             SELECT DISTINCT ?directoryOrg ?directoryOrg2 ?directoryOrg2_uri ?directoryOrg_order ?directoryOrg_protocolLevel ?directoryOrg_email ?directoryOrg_telephone ?directoryOrg_locality ?directoryOrg_postalCode ?directoryOrg_streetAddress ?directoryOrg_homepage             where {{?directoryOrg_uri org:hasSubOrganization ?directoryOrg2_uri.                     ?directoryOrg_uri skos:prefLabel ?directoryOrg.                     ?directoryOrg2_uri skos:prefLabel ?directoryOrg2;                                       euvoc:order ?directoryOrg_order;                                       euvoc:protocolLevel ?directoryOrg_protocolLevel.                                       #euvoc:contactPoint ?directoryOrg_contactPoint.                     #OPTIONAL {                     #?directoryOrg_uri2 euvoc:contactPoint ?directoryOrg_contactPoint2.                     #}                     #OPTIONAL {                     #?directoryOrg_contactPoint2 vcard:hasEmail ?directoryOrg_email2.                     #}                     #OPTIONAL {                     #?directoryOrg_contactPoint2 vcard:hasTelephone ?directoryOrg_telephoneBN2.                     #}                     #OPTIONAL {                     #?directoryOrg_contactPoint2 vcard:locality ?directoryOrg_locality2.                     #}                     #OPTIONAL {                     #?directoryOrg_contactPoint2 vcard:postal-code ?directoryOrg_postalCode2.                     #}                     #OPTIONAL {                     #?directoryOrg_contactPoint2 vcard:street-address ?directoryOrg_streetAddress2.                     #}                     #OPTIONAL {                     #?directoryOrg_contactPoint2 foaf:homepage ?directoryOrg_homepage2.                     #}                     #OPTIONAL {                     #?directoryOrg_telephoneBN2 vcard:hasValue ?directoryOrg_telephone2.                       #}                     }                     filter(?directoryOrg_uri=<PARAMETER>).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?directoryOrg2), "en")).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?directoryOrg), "en")).                    }                    #ORDER BY ?whoiswhoOrg ?country ?location                    #LIMIT 50

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>          PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>         PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#>                 SELECT DISTINCT ?opTheme ?opTheme_uri ?corporateBody ?corporateBody_uri ?opTheme_uri AS ?corporateBody_opTheme                 where {{?publicationDocument_uri cdm:publication_general_is_about_concept_op_theme ?opTheme_uri;                            cdm:work_authored_by_agent ?corporateBody_uri.                         ?opTheme_uri skos:prefLabel ?opTheme.                         ?corporateBody_uri skos:prefLabel ?corporateBody.                         }                         filter(?opTheme_uri=<PARAMETER>)                        FILTER(langMatches(lang(?corporateBody), "en")).                        FILTER(langMatches(lang(?opTheme), "en")).                        }ORDER BY ?opTheme ?corporateBody

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>      PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>     PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>     PREFIX euvoc: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/euvoc#>             SELECT DISTINCT ?eurovoc ?eurovoc_uri ?eurovocDomain ?eurovocDomain_uri ?eurovocThesauri ?eurovocThesauri_uri ?eurovocConcept ?eurovocConcept_uri             where {{?eurovoc_uri dcterms:hasPart ?eurovocThesauri_uri;                        skos:prefLabel ?eurovoc.                     ?eurovocThesauri_uri skos:prefLabel ?eurovocThesauri;                        euvoc:domain ?eurovocDomain_uri.                     ?eurovocDomain_uri skos:prefLabel ?eurovocDomain.                     ?eurovocConcept_uri skos:inScheme ?eurovocThesauri_uri;                              skos:prefLabel ?eurovocConcept.                     }                     filter(?eurovoc_uri=<http://eurovoc.europa.eu/100141>).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?eurovocDomain), "en"))                     FILTER(langMatches(lang(?eurovocThesauri), "en"))                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?eurovoc), "en"))                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?eurovocConcept), "en"))                     }ORDER BY ?eurovoc ?eurovocDomain ?eurovocThesauri ?eurovocConcept
option_text: Eurovoc concepts by thesauri and domain

query: PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>      SELECT ?eurovocConcept ?eurovocConcept_uri ?aligment WHERE {     ?eurovocConcept_uri skos:inScheme <http://eurovoc.europa.eu/100141> ;     skos:prefLabel ?eurovocConcept     {?eurovocConcept_uri skos:exactMatch ?aligment}     UNION     {?eurovocConcept_uri skos:closeMatch ?aligment}     #filter (strStarts(str(?aligment), 'https://en.wikipedia.org/')).     FILTER(langMatches(lang(?eurovocConcept), "en")).     filter(?eurovocConcept_uri=<PARAMETER>). }ORDER BY ?eurovocConcept ?aligment

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>      PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>     PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>      SELECT DISTINCT ?nuts ?nutsLevel0 ?nutsLevel0_uri ?nutsLevel1 ?nutsLevel1_uri ?nutsLevel2 ?nutsLevel2_uri ?nutsLevel3 ?nutsLevel3_uri     where {{?nutsLevel3_uri ?p ?o;                skos:prefLabel ?nutsLevel3;                skos:broader ?nutsLevel2_uri.             ?nutsLevel2_uri skos:prefLabel ?nutsLevel2;                              skos:broader ?nutsLevel1_uri.             ?nutsLevel1_uri skos:prefLabel ?nutsLevel1;                              skos:broader ?nutsLevel0_uri.             ?nutsLevel0_uri skos:prefLabel ?nutsLevel0;                              skos:inScheme <http://data.europa.eu/nuts>.             <http://data.europa.eu/nuts> skos:prefLabel ?nuts             }             FILTER(?p=<http://data.europa.eu/nuts/level>).            FILTER(?o=3)             }ORDER BY ?nuts ?nutsLevel0 ?nutsLevel1 ?nutsLevel2 ?nutsLevel3

PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>     PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>     PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#>             SELECT DISTINCT ?taxonomy ?taxonomy_def ?taxonomyType ?taxonomyType_uri ?taxonomyType_desc ?taxonomyLevel1 ?taxonomyLevel1_uri ?taxonomyLevel1_definition             where {{<http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/dataset-type/TAXONOMY> skos:prefLabel ?taxonomy;                        skos:definition ?taxonomy_def.                     ?s cdm:work_dataset_has_type_concept_type_dataset <http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/dataset-type/TAXONOMY>;                        cdm:work_id ?taxonomyType_uri;                        cdm:work_dataset_description_editorial ?taxonomyType_desc;                        cdm:work_title ?taxonomyType.                     BIND(IRI(?taxonomyType_uri) as ?idUri)                     ?idUri skos:hasTopconcept ?taxonomyLevel1_uri.                     ?taxonomyLevel1_uri skos:prefLabel ?taxonomyLevel1.                     OPTIONAL {?taxonomyLevel1_uri skos:definition ?taxonomyLevel1_definition }                     #?idUri skos:prefLabel ?label                     FILTER(langMatches(lang(?taxonomy), "en")).                     FILTER(langMatches(lang(?taxonomyLevel1), "en")).                     #FILTER(langMatches(lang(?label), "en")).                        }                    } ORDER BY ?taxonomy ?taxonomyType ?taxonomyLevel1

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>      PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>             SELECT DISTINCT ?taxonomyLevel1 ?taxonomyLevel1_uri ?taxonomyLevel2 ?taxonomyLevel2_uri                     WHERE{{                     ?taxonomyLevel1_uri skos:prefLabel ?taxonomyLevel1;                                          skos:narrower ?taxonomyLevel2_uri.                     ?taxonomyLevel2_uri skos:prefLabel ?taxonomyLevel2                     }                     filter(?taxonomyLevel1_uri=<PARAMETER>).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?taxonomyLevel2), "en"))                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?taxonomyLevel1), "en"))                    }ORDER BY ?taxonomyLevel1 ?taxonomyLevel2

PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>     PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>     PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#>             SELECT DISTINCT ?det ?det_uri ?detLevel1 ?detLevel1_uri ?detLevel2 ?detLevel2_uri             where {{ ?det_uri skos:prefLabel ?det;                                skos:hasTopConcept ?detLevel1_uri.                     ?detLevel1_uri skos:prefLabel ?detLevel1;                                skos:narrower ?detLevel2_uri.                     ?detLevel2_uri skos:prefLabel ?detLevel2.                     FILTER(langMatches(lang(?detLevel1), "en")).                     FILTER(langMatches(lang(?detLevel2), "en")).                     #FILTER(langMatches(lang(?taxonomyLevel1), "en")).                     #FILTER(langMatches(lang(?label), "en")).                     FILTER(?det_uri=<http://data.europa.eu/uxp/det>)                        }                    } ORDER BY ?det ?det ?detLevel1

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>      PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>     PREFIX purl: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>     PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>     PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#>     PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>             SELECT DISTINCT ?eurovocConcept ?eurovocConcept_uri ?workType ?workType_uri ?work ?work_uri             where {{?eurovocConcept_uri skos:prefLabel ?eurovocConcept.                     ?work_uri cdm:work_is_about_concept_eurovoc ?eurovocConcept_uri;                           rdfs:type ?workType_uri;                           cdm:work_title ?work.                     ?workType_uri rdf:label ?workType                     }                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?eurovocConcept), "en"))                     FILTER(?eurovocConcept_uri=<PARAMETER>)                    FILTER (isLiteral(?workType) && lcase(str(?workType)) != "work")                    }                    ORDER BY ?eurovocConcept ?workType ?work
option_text: Eurovoc concepts and works by type

query: PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>      PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>             SELECT DISTINCT ?detLevel2 ?detLevel2_uri ?detLevel3 ?detLevel3_uri                     WHERE{{                     ?detLevel2_uri skos:prefLabel ?detLevel2;                                          skos:narrower ?detLevel3_uri.                     ?detLevel3_uri skos:prefLabel ?detLevel3                     }                     filter(?detLevel2_uri=<PARAMETER>).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?detLevel2), "en"))                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?detLevel3), "en"))                    }ORDER BY ?detLevel2 ?detLevel3

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>      PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>             SELECT DISTINCT ?detLevel1 ?detLevel1_uri ?eurovocConcept ?eurovocConcept_uri             where {{?detLevel1_uri skos:prefLabel ?detLevel1;                                     skos:exactMatch ?eurovocConcept_uri.                     ?eurovocConcept_uri skos:prefLabel ?eurovocConcept}                     filter(?detLevel1_uri=<PARAMETER>).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?detLevel1), "en")).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?eurovocConcept), "en")).                    }

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>              PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>             PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>             PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#>             PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>             PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>             PREFIX authority: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/authority/>                     SELECT DISTINCT ?continent ?continent_uri ?continentName ?continentName_uri ?country ?country_uri ?language ?language_uri                      where {{?continentName_uri skos:prefLabel ?continentName;                                skos:inScheme ?continent_uri.                             ?continent_uri skos:prefLabel ?continent.                             ?country_uri geo:sfWithin ?continentName_uri;                                          skos:prefLabel ?country;                                          authority:deprecated ?deprecated;                                          dcterms:language ?language_uri.                             ?language_uri skos:prefLabel ?language                             }                             filter(?continent_uri=<http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/continent>).                            FILTER(langMatches(lang(?continent), "en")).                            FILTER(langMatches(lang(?continentName), "en")).                            FILTER(langMatches(lang(?country), "en")).                            filter(?deprecated="false").                            FILTER(langMatches(lang(?language), "en")).                            }ORDER BY ?continent ?continentName ?country ?language

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>              PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>             PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>             PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#>             PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>             PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>             PREFIX authority: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/authority/>             PREFIX org: <http://www.w3.org/ns/org#>                     SELECT DISTINCT ?continent ?continent_uri ?continentName ?continentName_uri ?country_uri ?country ?org ?org_code ?org_desc                     where {{?continentName_uri skos:prefLabel ?continentName;                                skos:inScheme ?continent_uri.                             ?continent_uri skos:prefLabel ?continent.                             ?country_uri geo:sfWithin ?continentName_uri;                                          skos:prefLabel ?country;                                          authority:deprecated ?deprecated.                             OPTIONAL {                                     ?country_uri org:hasMembership ?o.                                     ?o org:organization ?org_code.                                     ?org_code authority:deprecated ?deprecated2;                                               authority:authority-code ?org;                                               skos:prefLabel ?org_desc.                                     filter(?deprecated2="false").                                     FILTER(langMatches(lang(?org_desc), "en")).                             }                             }                             filter(?continent_uri=<http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/continent>).                            FILTER(langMatches(lang(?continent), "en")).                            FILTER(langMatches(lang(?continentName), "en")).                            FILTER(langMatches(lang(?country), "en")).                            filter(?deprecated="false").                            }ORDER BY ?continent ?continentName ?country ?org
option_text: Continents countries and organisations those countries belong to

query: PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>      PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>     PREFIX org: <http://www.w3.org/ns/org#>     PREFIX geo: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>     PREFIX geosparql: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>     PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>     PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>             SELECT DISTINCT ?eurun ?eurun_uri ?eurun_image ?corporateBody ?corporateBody_uri ?corporateBody_image ?corporateBody_country ?corporateBody_countryUri ?corporateBody_location ?corporateBody_locationUri                where {{?eurun_uri org:hasSubOrganization ?corporateBody_uri;                            skos:prefLabel ?eurun;                            foaf:depiction ?eurun_image.                     ?corporateBody_uri skos:prefLabel ?corporateBody;                        foaf:depiction ?corporateBody_image;                        geo:location ?corporateBody_locationUri.                     ?corporateBody_locationUri skos:prefLabel ?corporateBody_location;                               geosparql:sfWithin ?corporateBody_countryUri.                     ?corporateBody_countryUri skos:prefLabel ?corporateBody_country                               }                     filter(?eurun_uri=<http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/corporate-body/EURUN>).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?eurun), "en")).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?corporateBody), "en")).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?corporateBody_location), "en")).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?corporateBody_country), "en")).                    }ORDER BY ?eurun ?corporateBody                    #LIMIT 50

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>      PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>     PREFIX org: <http://www.w3.org/ns/org#>     PREFIX geo: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>     PREFIX geosparql: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>     PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>     PREFIX euvoc: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/euvoc#>     PREFIX vcard: <http://www.w3.org/2006/vcard/ns#>             SELECT DISTINCT ?corporateBody ?directoryOrg ?directoryOrg_uri ?directoryOrg_order ?directoryOrg_protocolLevel ?directoryOrg_email ?directoryOrg_telephone ?directoryOrg_locality ?directoryOrg_postalCode ?directoryOrg_streetAddress ?directoryOrg_homepage             where {{?corporateBody_uri skos:prefLabel ?corporateBody.                     ?corporateBody_uri org:hasSubOrganization ?directoryOrg_uri.                      ?directoryOrg_uri skos:prefLabel ?directoryOrg.                     OPTIONAL {                     ?directoryOrg_uri euvoc:order ?directoryOrg_order.                     }                     OPTIONAL {                     ?directoryOrg_uri euvoc:protocolLevel ?directoryOrg_protocolLevel.                     }                     #OPTIONAL {                     #?directoryOrg_uri euvoc:contactPoint ?directoryOrg_contactPoint.                     #}                     #OPTIONAL {                     #?directoryOrg_contactPoint vcard:hasEmail ?directoryOrg_email.                     #}                     #OPTIONAL {                     #?directoryOrg_contactPoint vcard:hasTelephone ?directoryOrg_telephoneBN.                     #}                     #OPTIONAL {                     #?directoryOrg_contactPoint vcard:locality ?directoryOrg_locality.                     #}                     #OPTIONAL {                     #?directoryOrg_contactPoint vcard:postal-code ?directoryOrg_postalCode.                     #}                     #OPTIONAL {                     #?directoryOrg_contactPoint vcard:street-address ?directoryOrg_streetAddress.                     #}                     #OPTIONAL {                     #?directoryOrg_contactPoint foaf:homepage ?directoryOrg_homepage.                     #}                     #OPTIONAL {                     #?directoryOrg_telephoneBN vcard:hasValue ?directoryOrg_telephone.                       #}                     }                     filter(?corporateBody_uri=<PARAMETER>).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?directoryOrg), "en")).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?corporateBody), "en")).                    }                    #ORDER BY ?whoiswhoOrg ?country ?location                    #LIMIT 50

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> PREFIX org: <http://www.w3.org/ns/org#> PREFIX euvoc: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/euvoc#> SELECT DISTINCT ?directoryOrg ?membership ?directoryOrg_uri AS ?membership_directoryOrg ?membership_startDate ?membership_order where {{?membership_uri org:organization ?directoryOrg_uri;         euvoc:order ?membership_order;         euvoc:positionComplement ?membership;         euvoc:startDate ?membership_startDate;         euvoc:order ?membership_order.         ?directoryOrg_uri skos:prefLabel ?directoryOrg.        }         filter(?directoryOrg_uri=<PARAMETER>).        FILTER(langMatches(lang(?membership), "en")).        FILTER(langMatches(lang(?directoryOrg), "en")).       }GROUP BY ?membership

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>      PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>     PREFIX org: <http://www.w3.org/ns/org#>     PREFIX euvoc: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/euvoc#>     PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>     PREFIX resource: <http://publications.europa.eu/resource/>             SELECT DISTINCT ?membership ?membership_uri ?membership_startDate ?membership_endDate ?membership_order ?membership_positionStatusUri ?membership_positionStatus ?person ?person_uri ?person_id ?person_image ?person_citiz ?person_gender ?person_genderUri             where {{?membership_uri org:organization ?directoryOrg_uri;                        euvoc:startDate ?membership_startDate;                        euvoc:endDate ?membership_endDate;                        euvoc:order ?membership_order;                        euvoc:positionComplement ?membership;                        euvoc:positionStatus ?membership_positionStatusUri.                        #euvoc:roleQualification ?roleQualification_uri;                        #euvoc:contactPoint ?contactPoint.                     ?directoryOrg_uri skos:prefLabel ?directoryOrg.                     ?membership_positionStatusUri skos:prefLabel ?membership_positionStatus.                     ?person_uri org:hasMembership ?membership_uri;                     #            vcard:hasGender ?person_genderUri;                                 foaf:name ?person.                     #?person_genderUri skos:prefLabel ?person_gender.                     OPTIONAL{                         ?person_uri foaf:img ?person_image;                                     resource:personcitizenship ?person_citizUri.                         ?person_citizUri skos:prefLabel ?person_citiz.                         FILTER(langMatches(lang(?person_citiz), "en")).                         BIND (STRBEFORE(STRAFTER( STR(?person_image), "https://www.europarl.europa.eu/mepphoto/" ), ".jpg" ) AS ?person_id)                         #BIND (regex(STR(?person_img), "^https", "i") AS ?str_event)                     }                     }                     FILTER(STR(?membership)="PARAMETER").                    filter(?directoryOrg_uri=<PARAMETER2>).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?membership), "en")).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?membership_positionStatus), "en")).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?directoryOrg), "en")).                    #FILTER(langMatches(lang(?person_gender), "en")).                    }ORDER BY ?membership_order ?person

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>          PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>         PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#>         SELECT DISTINCT ?opThemeParent ?opThemeParent_uri ?opThemeChild ?opThemeChild_uri         where {{?opThemeChild_uri skos:broader ?opThemeParent_uri;                    skos:prefLabel ?opThemeChild.                 ?opThemeParent_uri skos:prefLabel ?opThemeParent.                 }                 filter(?opThemeParent_uri=<PARAMETER>)                FILTER(langMatches(lang(?opThemeParent), "en")).                FILTER(langMatches(lang(?opThemeChild), "en")).                }ORDER BY ?opThemeParent ?opThemeChild

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>      PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>     PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#>             SELECT DISTINCT ?expression ?expression_uri ?manifestation ?manifestation_uri ?manifestation_image ?manifestation_type             where {                     {                     ?manifestation_uri cdm:manifestation_manifests_expression ?expression_uri.                     ?manifestation_uri cdm:manifestation_has_thumbnail ?manifestation_image;                                        cdm:manifestation_number_catalogue ?manifestation;                                        cdm:manifestation_type ?manifestation_type.                                        #cdm:manifestation_isbn ?manifestation_isbn.                     ?expression_uri cdm:expression_title ?expression.                     }                     filter(?expression_uri=<PARAMETER>)                    }ORDER BY ?expression ?manifestation

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>      PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>     PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#>             SELECT DISTINCT ?corporateBody ?corporateBody_uri ?publicationDocument ?publicationDocument_uri ?publicationDocument_documentUri ?publicationDocument_date             where {{?publicationDocument_documentUri cdm:publication_general_is_about_concept_op_theme ?opTheme_uri;                        cdm:work_authored_by_agent ?corporateBody_uri.                     ?opTheme_uri skos:prefLabel ?opTheme.                     ?corporateBody_uri skos:prefLabel ?corporateBody.                     ?publicationDocument_documentUri cdm:work_date_document ?publicationDocument_date.                     ?publicationDocument_uri cdm:expression_belongs_to_work ?publicationDocument_documentUri;                        cdm:expression_uses_language ?expression_languageUri;                        cdm:expression_title ?publicationDocument.                     ?expression_languageUri skos:prefLabel ?expression_language.                     }                     filter(?opTheme_uri=<PARAMETER2>)                    filter(?corporateBody_uri=<PARAMETER>)                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?corporateBody), "en")).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?opTheme), "en")).                    FILTER(langMatches(lang(?expression_language), "en")).                    }ORDER BY ?corporateBody ?publicationDocument
